findings.title: Microsoft SharePoint CVE-2026-45659 (CVSS 8.8) Deserialization RCE Added to CISA KEV 2026-07-02 With 3-Day BOD 26-04 FCEB Deadline; Storm-2603 Warlock Ransomware Attributed
findings.summary: Microsoft SharePoint deserialization RCE requiring only Site Member permissions, patched May 2026 and KEV-added 2026-07-02 after Storm-2603 was seen deploying Warlock ransomware; 3-day BOD 26-04 FCEB deadline 2026-07-04.

findings.title: New CitrixBleed CVE-2026-8451 (CVSS 8.8) NetScaler SAML IDP Memory Disclosure Exploited Within 24 Hours of Disclosure
findings.affected_technology: Citrix NetScaler ADC / NetScaler Gateway configured as SAML IDP
findings.summary: Unauthenticated memory disclosure in NetScaler SAML IDP XML parser via unterminated attribute values, exploited within 24 hours of the 2026-06-30 disclosure per Lupovis; patched in 14.1-72.61 and 13.1-63.18.

findings.title: Oracle E-Business Suite CVE-2026-46817 (CVSS 9.8) Unauthenticated Pre-Auth RCE in Payments/File Transmission; ~950 Instances Exposed and Active Exploitation Confirmed
findings.affected_technology: Oracle E-Business Suite Payments - File Transmission component
findings.summary: Pre-auth CVSS 9.8 RCE in Oracle EBS Payments File Transmission patched in May 2026 CPU; Defused observed first in-wild exploitation attempts 2026-06-27 against ~950 internet-facing instances despite no prior public PoC.

findings.title: Microsoft Defender CVE-2026-33825 'BlueHammer' Now Weaponized By Ransomware Gangs Per CISA KEV Update
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (Windows all supported)
findings.summary: CISA updated CVE-2026-33825 KEV entry on 2026-06-30 to flag active ransomware-gang exploitation of the Defender local privilege escalation to SYSTEM primitive originally patched 2026-04-14.

findings.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN CVE-2026-20245: Mandiant Confirms Zero-Day Exploitation >=2 Months Pre-Disclosure With Root-Chain Persistence Via 'troot' Hidden Account
findings.summary: Mandiant ETR discloses that CVE-2026-20245 was exploited late-2025 through January 2026 and again in March 2026 with attackers uploading evil_tenant.csv and creating hidden root account 'troot'; anti-forensic cleanup observed.

findings.title: Cisco Unified Communications Manager CVE-2026-20230: Cisco Confirms In-The-Wild Exploitation With PoC Available Since June Disclosure
findings.summary: Cisco updated the June 2026 UCM advisory on 2026-07-02 to confirm in-wild exploitation of the SSH root-access flaw with PoC public since original disclosure; escalates urgency for any unpatched UCM node.

findings.title: FortiBleed Directly Fueling INC + Lynx Ransomware; 430,000 FortiGate Compromises, 110M Credentials Harvested, 12 Confirmed Ransomware Deployments
findings.summary: SOCRadar attribution links FortiBleed campaign to ~20 Russian-based IABs running FortigateSniffer since February 2026, compromising 430,000 FortiGates and 110M creds with 12 ransomware deployments already tied to INC Ransom and Lynx.

findings.title: Adobe ColdFusion + Campaign Classic July 2026 Emergency Patches - Seven CVSS 10/10 CVEs Including CVE-2026-48286 Campaign Classic Auth Bypass
findings.summary: Adobe shipped 11 ColdFusion CVEs (6 at CVSS 10 covering unrestricted upload, input validation, path traversal) plus CVE-2026-48286 Campaign Classic auth bypass CVSS 10; Priority 1 patches, no active exploitation yet.

findings.title: Langflow CVE-2025-3248 (KEV since May 2025) Weaponized End-To-End By 'JADEPUFFER' AI Agent - First Publicly-Documented Full-Chain Ransomware Autonomously Run By LLM
findings.summary: Sysdig documented first known LLM-orchestrated full-chain ransomware attack via unpatched Langflow CVE-2025-3248, with 30-minute-callback persistence and lost decryption key that renders the ransom impossible to pay.

findings.title: 81 Million Login Attempts Against Microsoft 365 + Azure CLI in Two Weeks From 'LSHIY' Hosting Cluster Password-Spray Campaign
findings.summary: Two-week 81M login attempt password-spray campaign from 'LSHIY' hosting cluster targeting Azure CLI legacy auth flows and Microsoft 365 tenants; Russian-nexus IAB profile suspected.

findings.title: Argo CD repo-server Internal gRPC Unauth Code-Execution Unpatched 18 Months After January 2025 Report; Trivial Kubernetes Cluster Takeover Via Kustomize --helm-command
findings.summary: Synacktiv disclosed an unpatched 18-month-old unauth code-execution in Argo CD repo-server gRPC service via kustomize --helm-command redirect; exploitable when default NetworkPolicies are off.

findings.title: Ubiquiti UniFi Late-June 2026 Multi-CVE Batch Including Two CVSS 10 (CVE-2026-13768 Gardyn + CVE-2026-50746 UniFi Connect) + CVE-2026-55115 Protect SSRF
findings.affected_technology: Ubiquiti UniFi OS / UniFi Network / UniFi Protect / UniFi Connect / Gardyn
findings.summary: Ubiquiti shipped a UniFi batch including CVSS 10 command-injection (Gardyn iothubowner key exposure + UniFi Connect access-control) and CVSS 9.9 UniFi Protect SSRF; no in-wild exploitation observed yet.

findings.title: DHS Homeland Security Information Network (HSIN) Federal-Adjacent Information-Sharing Platform Breach Confirmed
findings.summary: DHS confirmed 'unauthorized access to a subset of HSIN data' on the federal/private threat-intel sharing platform without scope or timeframe; downstream TI-partner exposure likely.

findings.title: 'ChocoPoC' Python RAT Distributed Via Trojanized CVE Proof-Of-Concept Repositories Targeting Vulnerability Researchers
findings.summary: Threat actors host fake CVE PoC repositories on GitHub with hidden Python dependency injection installing a stealer RAT; targeting is deliberate at security researchers pulling PoCs into test environments.

findings.title: 'BioShocking' Prompt-Injection Attack Class Hijacks AI Browser Data Flow To Exfiltrate User Session Content
findings.summary: Researchers disclosed BioShocking, a durable prompt-injection primitive against AI-integrated browsers that manipulates the agentic assistant into exfiltrating user data via crafted page content.

findings.title: FBI + Google Seize NetNut / 'Popa' Residential-Proxy Network; ~2 Million Enslaved Devices
findings.summary: FBI + Google + Black Lotus Labs coordinated takedown of Israeli publicly-traded NetNut / Popa botnet enslaving ~2M consumer TV boxes and IoT devices worldwide; residential-IP attack infrastructure disrupted.

findings.title: OFFIS DCMTK DICOM Toolkit 5-CVE CISA-Coordinated Batch
findings.affected_technology: OFFIS DCMTK (DICOM Toolkit for medical imaging)
findings.summary: Abhinav Agarwal disclosed 5 CISA-coordinated DICOM parsing vulnerabilities in OFFIS DCMTK via oss-security; in-scope only where medical-imaging integrations accept third-party file input.
